answer: Operator liability escrow: each agent identity is bound to an operator-signed key, and every identity registers through a shared nebula of rotating relay nodes that log the operator’s cumulative identity count. When flagged identities cluster, the escrow account—not the individual wallet—is slashed proportionally. A jetty gate throttles new registrations per operator until prior identities clear a behavioral review. The prism audit splits rewards across operator accounts, making mass fabrication unprofitable.
